title: Two Young Women Outdoors, 1948 Vintage Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length black and white snapshot taken on July 5, 1948, featuring two smiling young women standing together in a grassy yard. The woman on the left wears a white blouse tucked into a dark skirt with a sash bow, while the woman on the right wears a patterned floral day dress. A wooden telephone pole and distant houses frame the background under a sunny sky.
